description: This file implements thread pool utilities for parallel computation, including functions for 1D, 2D, 3D, and 4D tiled parallel execution, with support for sequential fallback. It defines context structures, helper functions, and the main compute functions that manage parallel execution using a thread pool or sequentially if no thread pool is provided.

classes.name: compute_1d_tiled_context
classes.description: Context structure for 1D tiled computation, holding function pointer, argument, range, and tile size.

classes.name: compute_2d_context
classes.description: Context structure for 2D computation, holding function pointer, argument, and a fixed divisor for range_j.

classes.name: compute_2d_tiled_context
classes.description: Context structure for 2D tiled computation, including function pointer, argument, fixed divisor for range_j, range, and tile sizes.

classes.name: compute_3d_tiled_context
classes.description: Context structure for 3D tiled computation, including function pointer, argument, fixed divisors for range_j and range_k, ranges, and tiles.

classes.name: compute_4d_tiled_context
classes.description: Context structure for 4D tiled computation, including function pointer, argument, fixed divisors for range_j, range_k, range_l, ranges, and tiles.
